sql.reader_access: No PUBLIC grants. React gets USAGE on mdm_steward and SELECT on the policy-case and receipt relations only. MDM owns all writes. The initial single-scope profile does not use RLS.
sql.opening_time: opened_at is publications.published_at for reviews.opened_revision. If unavailable, opened_at is null and opened_at_source is unknown; automatic SET_DUE_AT is denied until audited administrator backfill. resolved_at comes from the publication that resolved the occurrence when available.
sql.case_key: Allocate once per review_id from mdm_internal.policy_case_key_seq. Gaps after rollback are valid. Resolved occurrences and keys are retained; recurrence creates a new review_id and key.

receipts.reader_access: React receives SELECT only. No PUBLIC grant. MDM alone inserts or changes receipts.
receipts.retention: Retain request bodies and receipts without automatic deletion in v1 and include them in logical dump.

freshness.stewardship_epoch_meaning: The decision_epoch associated with the latest successful observation. It may be older than the current entity decision_epoch; pending_stewardship is true in that case.
freshness.action_revision: Increment only when evidence or an action control can change policy eligibility or result. Observation timestamps, receipt writes, and unrelated publication advances do not increment it.

intent.signature: mdm_steward.submit_policy_intent(binding_id uuid, request_key bytea, case_key bigint, action text, arguments jsonb, expected_review_version bigint, expected_definition_version bigint, expected_publication_revision bigint, expected_stewardship_epoch bigint, expected_evidence_basis_digest bytea, expected_action_revision bigint, expected_policy_digest bytea, policy_revision text, evaluation_ref text, work_ref text)

request_key.encoding: React derives the key from the request_key_vector using canonical_encoding.version. case_key identifies one immutable review occurrence. lifecycle_generation starts at 1 and increases only when React starts a new work lifecycle for that case; retries keep it unchanged. escalation_level is the target level for ESCALATE and zero for other actions.
inputs: non-empty UTF-8 text, at most 256 bytes
non-empty UTF-8 text, at most 256 bytes
nonnegative integer; zero except for ESCALATE

intent.references: policy_revision, evaluation_ref, work_ref are non-empty text, each at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
intent.argument_keys: Each action accepts exactly its listed keys; extra keys, null values, and wrong JSON types are rejected.

idempotency.authorization: Authenticate and validate the binding before looking up a receipt.
idempotency.same_body: For the same binding_id, request_key, and canonical request digest, return the original receipt without repeating the control change.
idempotency.concurrent_insert: After a unique-key conflict, read the existing receipt and compare request digests. Return that receipt for an equal body or the changed_body response for a different body. Never replace the existing row or retry with a new key.

intent.publication: Every v1 intent has resulting_publication_revision null. Accepted control changes do not resolve identity or publish MDM output.
intent.authority: The bound automation role may submit only the three typed actions. It cannot decide, override golden values, refresh, rebuild, merge, split, or approve.
intent.receipts: Create one immutable receipt for each first authorized request, including terminal validation outcomes. Replays return that receipt. IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT is returned without a receipt row.

canonical_encoding.json: UTF-8 compact JSON; object keys sorted by UTF-8 byte order; array order preserved; strings use RFC 8259 escaping; numbers are base-10 integers without leading zeroes; floating point values are forbidden.
canonical_encoding.digest: SHA-256 over each part framed by an unsigned 32-bit big-endian byte length. First part is the UTF-8 domain tag, second part is the canonical JSON bytes.
canonical_encoding.intent_request_body: Contains every submit_policy_intent input except request_key. The request_key is the idempotency lookup key and is not included in the body digest.

shared_conformance_cases: React derives the same request key when it retries the same persisted work.
The same binding, request key, and body return the original immutable receipt.
A changed body with the same binding and request key returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT with a null receipt_id; it leaves the stored receipt unchanged and creates no row.
Concurrent submissions with the same key return the original receipt for an equal body and the conflict response for a different body.
The receipt actor is the authenticated effective database role captured by MDM; the caller cannot provide it.
Stale review, definition, publication basis, stewardship epoch, evidence digest, action revision, or policy digest cannot apply a control.
A newer unrelated publication does not stale an unchanged case basis.
Manual assignment protection denies automatic queue replacement.
Pause, binding replacement, and policy mismatch create the specified terminal outcome.
Receipt and control change commit atomically or both roll back.
Resolved occurrences remain readable and recurrence gets a new case key.
Restore preserves case keys, request bodies, and receipts.
